component-o.description-s: 2.5-5.5 V input, 2 A, 1.5 MHz synchronous step-down converter, adjustable output 0.6 V to VIN, SOT-23-5

cfgpins-ao.1c: EN high (VIH 1.2 V max) enables, do not leave floating: tied to VIN

cfgpins-ao.5c: VFB 0.6 V; VOUT = 0.6 V x (1 + R1/R2): 300k / 150k gives the row's 1.8 V (TI typical application R1, R2 0603 1 %; C3 feed-forward optional)

specs-o.en_note-s: no internal pull: the EN input must be terminated and not left floating

en_source-o.table-s: Electrical Characteristics: VIL low-level threshold at EN 0.4 V min, VIH high-level threshold at EN 1.2 V max (2.5 V <= VIN <= 5.5 V)

specs-o.replaces_s: AP3429KTTR-G1 (NRND): same SOT-23-5 pin order EN/GND/LX/VIN/FB and VFB 0.6 V

sw_not_stated-o.sw_rise_ns: not stated in TLV62569DBVR.pdf: no switch rise-time row in its tables (27 pages)
sw_not_stated-o.sw_fall_ns: not stated in TLV62569DBVR.pdf: no switch fall-time row in its tables (27 pages)
sw_not_stated-o.sw_coss_pf: not stated in TLV62569DBVR.pdf: no switch-pin or C_oss capacitance row in its tables (27 pages)

vref_source-o.table-s: 6.5 Electrical Characteristics, OUTPUT: VFB feedback regulation voltage 0.588 / 0.6 / 0.612 V

cout_source-o.table-s: 8.2.2.5 Input and Output Capacitor Selection: 'designed to operate with an output capacitor of 10 uF to 47 uF, as outlined in Table 4' (Table 4 p9: 2.2 uH with 10 uF standard; 22 uF and 2x22 uF also checked; effective C may vary +20 %/-50 %)

iout_source-o.table-s: 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: IOUT output current max 2 A

specs-o.loop_note-s: internally compensated; a 6.8 pF feed-forward capacitor across R2 (100 k) 'improves the loop bandwidth' (8.2.2.2, p9); no bandwidth figure

not_stated-o.load_transient: Figure 18/19 (p12): 0.8 A -> 2 A at 1 A/us, scope shot, no deviation figure stated

load_regulation_source-o.table-s: Figure 10. Load Regulation (curve points via pdf-graph)
load_regulation_source-o.derived: CCM portion 1.0 -> 1.994 A: VOUT 1.8 V +0.0005 % -> -0.3332 % = 6.01 mV / 0.994 A = 6.04 mV/A (matches the record's VOUT 1.8 V, so it is the klayout key); VOUT 3.3 V +0.0005 % -> -0.0079 % = 0.28 mV / 0.994 A = 0.28 mV/A (at the plot resolution; the curve is flat within +/-0.02 %). Below ~0.8 A the curve is the PFM offset
